digest.component_or_area: LLM eval harness / code-review concurrency overlay
propositions: A standing eval spec for the concurrency overlay must be authored to prevent silent regression of recall and precision behavior established against a corpus of real traced races.
The spec must define minimal diff hunks distilled from traced commits with provenance comments, using deterministic scorers and a gate of at_least(2) over 3 epochs.
The spec must include at least 2 scored recall cases (unlocked twin and TOCTOU check-then-act) with source commit references.
The spec must include at least 3 scored no-fire cases, including a hard false-positive control (deliberate probe-then-skip with real lock).
R3 (fail-open guard) must be present as a commented non-gating stretch case so it cannot fail the gate by construction.
The spec header must document that coverage_threshold is a run-success floor and the only per-run tolerance is gate: at_least(2) over epochs: 3.
